verdict.rationale: PayPal's Subscriptions docs say integrations can "Automate payment recovery for failed payments" and describe "automated payment recovery", which covers the core automatic-retry capability, but only in brief one-line mentions. The invoice payment reminders in the Invoicing product are a separate feature and are not credited here. Missing for 10: details on retry scheduling or configuration, smart/adaptive dunning logic, subscriber-facing recovery emails, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
